gaps.explanation: No fund column missing, nothing counted twice. Statement p4 (printed p14) fund columns vs detail: General Fund 80,714,197 (GAAP) vs General Fund budget-basis schedule p5 (printed p16) Total revenues 68,418,989 = -12,295,208; Community Betterment 1,168,019 vs budget schedule p6 (printed p17) 1,167,158 = -861; Debt Service 8,096,111 vs detail (statement column lines) 8,096,111 = 0; Other Governmental Funds 510,441 vs 510,441 = 0; plus the LB840 Funds schedule p10 (printed p56) revenues 44,189, which has no column of its own on p4 (its investment income sits inside the General Fund column: Other Governmental Funds investment income is only 517). 12,295,208 + 861 - 44,189 = 12,251,880 = gap. The General Fund difference is the printed budget basis: same rows printed lower on p5 than on p4, mainly Intergovernmental 11,898,996 vs 24,051,524, Property tax 24,879,351 vs 24,510,385, Permits, fees and licenses 9,763,753 vs Permits and licenses 1,860,746 + Fees 2,945,370 + Charges for services 5,416,609, Miscellaneous and reimbursements 1,749,083 vs 154,874 + 404,855, In-lieu 914,420 + Franchise 604,545 vs 1,506,561, Occupation 1,153,145 vs 1,338,210, Sales 17,455,696 vs 17,585,108; investment income 939,955 has no budget row. Adding the GAAP General column too would count the General Fund twice, so nothing is added.

Per fund: General Fund GAAP column p4 Total expenditures 73,898,501 vs budget schedule p5 Total expenditures 69,268,460 = 4,630,041; Community Betterment 298,041 vs p6 297,597 = 444; Debt Service 6,176,682 vs 6,176,682 and Other Governmental Funds 514,539 vs 514,539 (statement column lines in detail) = 0; LB840 Funds schedule p10 economic development 519,856 has no column on p4 (inside the General Fund column). 4,630,041 + 444 - 519,856 = 4,110,629 = gap. The budget schedule prints only four function rows (General services 5,827,650, Public safety 32,612,667, Community development 8,453,506, Public works 22,374,637) with no capital outlay or debt service rows, while the GAAP General column prints current 60,553,314 + Capital outlay 12,436,754 + debt service 908,433 (440,000 + 287,140 + 175,529 + 5,764); the budget function rows include capital outlay/debt on the budget basis (e.g. Public works 22,374,637 vs 19,790,437; Community development 8,453,506 vs 3,011,510). Adding the GAAP capital outlay / debt service rows would count General Fund money twice; nothing added.

Detail transfers in: General Fund budget 'Transfers in, net' 1,567,330 (p5; same figure in the p4 General column) + LB840 Funds 'Transfers' 750,000 (p10) = 2,317,330. Statement (JSON transfers_in 278,000) is the p4 Total column 'Transfers in (out), net' 278,000 = 1,567,330 - 755,000 (Community Betterment) - 534,330 (Debt Service); both transfers out are in detail as Transfers Out lines. So 1,289,330 of the gap is the Total column netting gross fund-column transfers, and 750,000 is the LB840 schedule's transfer, which is internal to the General Fund column on p4 (the General Fund's printed net 1,567,330 equals the transfers from Community Betterment 755,000 + Debt Service 534,330 + Waste Water 278,000, so the 750,000 is not a transfer between p4 columns). 1,289,330 + 750,000 = 2,039,330. Both are printed lines; nothing is a duplicate of another detail line.
